notes.title: Rework Progress And Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and thank you for taking the time to read about the exciting updates coming to our game!

Since the initial release, I've been on a journey of learning and growth with Unreal Engine, transitioning to Unreal Engine 5. This evolution has given me a fresh perspective, leading to the decision to remake the game entirely. While the core gameplay remains, expect a comprehensive overhaul with improved visuals and enhanced mechanics.

Check out the quick video teaser featuring intense boss fights, new AI challenges, and the introduction of abilities like slow-mo and speed boosts that can be combined for dynamic gameplay.

In the upcoming version, players will earn experience points (XP) by taking down zombies and other AI foes. Use your XP to unlock new abilities and features, adding depth to your gaming experience.

Now, I need your input! We're considering introducing a base-building mechanic, and I'd love to hear your thoughts. Two potential approaches are on the table: a dedicated map where you can customize your environment with various meshes, or the inclusion of deployable items within existing maps for strategic advantage.

This year holds promising developments for the game, and I'm excited to share this journey with you. Your feedback is crucial, so let me know what you think about the proposed base-building mechanics.

Stay tuned for an epic year of improvements and surprises!

Thank you for your support

notes.title: Update progress
notes.notes:
Update progress is at full speed, Here is where I want to outline some progress we have made so far, We Also expect this HUGE update to come out in the next few months, So all the things below are NOT yet live.

Fixed for Zombie spawning (Sometimes they would get stuck or). 
Fixed Zombies spawning time(There was a chance the zombie timer would get stuck at 1 meaning the zombies would stop spawning). 
Fixed reloading when sprinting. 
Disabled VR Plugin for now (i plan to bring VR later down the line now I have a VR). 
Fixed a small chance the HUD would get stuck when loading into a game.
Fixed “RevivingPlayer” text stuck on screen 
Fixed an issue with players getting stuck on spectate screen Fixed a small chance that players would spawn in seeing other people progress
           
Added 8 different player-able characters all with strengths and weaknesses (You pick how you play, Want to have more health but less movement speed).

Added in a new XP and Quest system (Quest may or may not be fully in when the update is live, If it is now we have all the code there ready to add more later). 

Our map dev is working on 3 new maps for the game. 

Updated some Hud elements to make it feel cleaner.

Made it so players can act as soul boxes (with limits).
 
Added in new guns

Added Melee weapons into the game.

DLSS Will be set with each map you play. This will be automictic and be set as balanced, This will only affect people will GPUs that support it and that is checked automictically (We do plan to have this as a graphic menu option)

Added the settings menu when you pause the game Before you had to leave the game fully, Now you don't.


We have more coming in the next few months and we thank you all for sticking with us, We are also committed to the goals we outlined in our early access statements
